units.title: Current Events / Actualidad

grammar.explanation_es: La voz pasiva enfatiza la acción sobre quién la hace: 'The law was passed', 'A decision has been made'.
examples: The new law was passed yesterday.
A decision has been made.
Taxes will be raised next year.
The report is being reviewed.
Millions were affected by the crisis.

story.text: The government announced a new ___ to reduce pollution. The decision was ___ after months of debate. Many citizens believe it will improve the ___ . However, some experts remain ___ about the long-term effects on the ___ .

sentences: The new law was passed yesterday.
Taxes will be raised next year.
The report is being reviewed carefully.

units.title: Conditionals / Condicionales

grammar.explanation_es: Para situaciones hipotéticas: 'If I were rich, I would travel'. Usamos 'were' para todas las personas.
examples: If I were rich, I would travel the world.
If she studied more, she would pass.
I wouldn't do that unless it was necessary.
We would help if we could.
Even if it rained, we would go.

story.text: If I ___ more time, I would learn three languages. I ___ travel to many countries and meet new people. Unless we ___ harder, we will not improve. ___ that you practice every day, fluency is possible. As long as you stay ___ , you will succeed.

sentences: If I were rich I would travel the world.
We would help if we could.
If she studied more she would pass.
I wouldn't do that unless necessary.

vocabulary.en: Cost an arm and a leg
vocabulary.es: Costar un ojo de la cara

grammar.explanation_es: Los modismos no se traducen literalmente. Apréndelos como bloques fijos y úsalos en contexto.
examples: The exam was a piece of cake.
Good luck! Break a leg!
I need to hit the books tonight.
I'm feeling under the weather today.
Hang in there, it gets easier.

units.title: Formal Writing / Escritura formal

grammar.explanation_es: Para contar lo que alguien dijo: 'He said that he was tired'. El verbo retrocede un tiempo.
examples: He said that he was busy.
She told me she would call.
They said they had finished.
I asked if he could help.
He explained that the report was ready.

story.text: I am writing to ___ about your recent order. ___ , we apologize for the delay. The product has been shipped and is ___ to this email. ___ , please contact us if you have questions. We look forward to hearing from you. ___ , the Support Team.

sentences: He said that he was busy.
She told me she would call later.
They said they had finished the report.
I am writing to request information.

units.title: Environment / Medio ambiente

grammar.explanation_es: 'will have + participio' para algo que estará terminado en el futuro: 'By 2050, sea levels will have risen'.
examples: By 2050, sea levels will have risen.
We must reduce pollution now.
If we don't act, the planet will suffer.
Renewable energy is becoming cheaper.
Many species have become endangered.

story.text: Scientists warn that ___ is one of the biggest threats today. To protect the planet, we must ___ more and reduce ___ . Switching to ___ energy can lower our carbon footprint. If we act now, future generations will inherit a more ___ world.

sentences: We should recycle more at home.
